newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates mostly lower to steady.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates mostly lower to steady.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were lower to steady in most maturities, with only the one-week rate inching up, traders said on Monday.
A trader said the slight rise in the one-week rate reflected the higher rates in the money market caused by weekend covering.
The one to six-month rates moved lower in line with the view the market is liquid inspite of the slightly higher money market rates which are seen as temporary, dealers said.
PHIBOR represents the rates banks are willing to swap their pesos for dollars.
